ov: جيري ماغواير (الإنجليزية: Jerry Maguire) فيلم أمريكي من إنتاج عام 1996، وهو من بطولة توم كروز، وكوبا غودينغ جونير، ورينيه زيلويجر، وكيلي بريستون.
plotEn:
Jerry Maguire is a slick 35-year-old sports agent working for Sports Management International (SMI).
He's confident, successful, studded with clients, and has little interest in anything except his comission.
But following criticism from an injured player's son, Jerry has an epiphany concerning his career, which leads him to write a mission statement about dishonesty in the business as well as his desire to work with fewer clients, and make less money.
In response, SMI management sends Bob Sugar, Jerry's protégé, to fire him. This sends both men racing to call  Jerry's clients, with Sugar pulling every trick in the book to steal them. 
Jerry speaks to Arizona Cardinals wide receiver Rod Tidwell, a smaller client who is unhappy with the amount of money being paid him. Rod tests Jerry's resolve through a long tirade on his lack of contract extension. By the end of the conversation, Jerry has held on to Rod Tidwell, but lost all his other clients to Sugar.
Leaving the office, Jerry
-fighting a breakdown- announces that he will start his own company, and asks who's coming with him. 
A question which everyone ignores with the exception of  26-year-old Dorothy Boyd, a single mother who  boldly follows him out, quitting her job then and there.
Frank "Cush" Cushman, a superstar quarterback prospect who is expected to be the number one NFL draft pick, initially says he will also stay with Jerry after he makes a personal visit to the Cushman home. 
Frank's father insists on a handshake
